entries.title: Numbers 30:1
segments: ¶Then Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, "This [is] the thing which the LORD has commanded:

entries.title: Numbers 30:2
segments: "If a man makes a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind himself by some agreement, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

entries.title: Numbers 30:3
segments: ¶"Or if a woman makes a vow to the LORD, and binds [herself] by some agreement while in her father's house in her youth,

entries.title: Numbers 30:4
segments: "and her father hears her vow and the agreement by which she has bound herself, and her father holds his peace, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement with which she has bound herself shall stand.

entries.title: Numbers 30:5
segments: "But if her father overrules her on the day that he hears, then none of her vows nor her agreements by which she has bound herself shall stand; and the LORD will release her, because her father overruled her.

entries.title: Numbers 30:6
segments: "If indeed she takes a husband, while bound by her vows or by a rash utterance from her lips by which she bound herself,

entries.title: Numbers 30:7
segments: "and her husband hears [it], and makes no response to her on the day that he hears, then her vows shall stand, and her agreements by which she bound herself shall stand.

entries.title: Numbers 30:8
segments: "But if her husband overrules her on the day that he hears [it], he shall make void her vow which she took and what she uttered with her lips, by which she bound herself, and the LORD will release her.

entries.title: Numbers 30:9
segments: "Also any vow of a widow or a divorced woman, by which she has bound herself, shall stand against her.

entries.title: Numbers 30:10
segments: "If she vowed in her husband's house, or bound herself by an agreement with an oath,

entries.title: Numbers 30:11
segments: "and her husband heard [it], and made no response to her [and] did not overrule her, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement by which she bound herself shall stand.

entries.title: Numbers 30:12
segments: "But if her husband truly made them void on the day he heard [them], then whatever proceeded from her lips concerning her vows or concerning the agreement binding her, it shall not stand; her husband has made them void, and the LORD will release her.

entries.title: Numbers 30:13
segments: "Every vow and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband may confirm it, or her husband may make it void.

entries.title: Numbers 30:14
segments: "Now if her husband makes no response whatever to her from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all the agreements that bind her; he confirms them, because he made no response to her on the day that he heard [them].

entries.title: Numbers 30:15
segments: "But if he does make them void after he has heard [them], then he shall bear her guilt."

entries.title: Numbers 30:16
segments: These [are] the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth in her father's house.
